hooks.command: file="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$file" in *Makefile.PL|*/cpanfile) echo 'BLOCK: This file is generated by dzil build. Edit dist.ini or maint/Makefile_header.PL instead.' >&2; exit 1;; esac
file="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; case "$file" in *.xs|*.pm) dir=$(dirname "$file"); if [ -f "$dir/Makefile" ]; then make -C "$dir" 2>&1 | tail -10; fi;; esac
